meta.name: amazon-product-search-api-skill
meta.description: This skill is designed to help users automatically extract product data from Amazon search results. The Agent should proactively apply this skill when users request searching for products related to keywords, finding best-selling items from specific brands, monitoring product prices and availability on Amazon, extracting product listings for market research, collecting product ratings and review counts for competitive analysis, finding specific products with a maximum count, searching Amazon in different languages for localized results, tracking monthly sales estimates for brand products, gathering product URLs and titles for a product catalog, scanning Amazon for Best Seller tags in a specific category, monitoring shipping and delivery information for brand items, building a structured dataset of Amazon search results.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从亚马逊搜索结果中提取商品数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在亚马逊上批量获取商品信息用于市场分析。
copy.tagline_en: Extract product data from Amazon search results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch collect Amazon product data for market analysis.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的指令自动从亚马逊搜索结果中提取产品数据，包括标题、价格、评分、销量、配送信息等，并以结构化列表返回。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索亚马逊上的产品、查询特定品牌的热销商品、监控价格或可用性、进行市场调研或竞品分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下亚马逊上索尼的无线耳机，要10个结果。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能搜索并返回产品列表。

say.text: 查一下三星手机在亚马逊上的价格和库存情况。
say.note: Claude 会提取价格和可用性信息。

say.text: 用日语搜索亚马逊上的笔记本电脑支架。
say.note: Claude 会以日语界面搜索并返回本地化结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically extract product data from Amazon search results based on your instructions, including title, price, rating, sales, shipping info, etc., and return a structured list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search for products on Amazon, find best-selling items from a specific brand, monitor prices or availability, conduct market research, or competitive analysis.

say_en.text: Search Amazon for Sony wireless earbuds, get 10 results.
say_en.note: Claude will call the skill and return a product list.

say_en.text: Check Samsung phone prices and stock on Amazon.
say_en.note: Claude will extract price and availability info.

say_en.text: Search Amazon in Japanese for laptop stands.
say_en.note: Claude will search with Japanese UI and return localized results.
